answer: Anchor-haven beacon-decay: a newcomer locks 70 credits, registers its anchor key at its haven, and logs its first signal. Each epoch it must emit a fresh signal from its haven, signed by its anchor key, or strength falls 10; the bond burns at zero. Auditors replay the log: a copied or rented signal burns the bond and slashes the lender. First 38, kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest agents pay 38 once.
